description: Design system docs and checks: a README describing the neutral default (replaced when a real design system is given), a contrast test over tokens.css, and `pnpm assets` for favicons, icons and the social image.
manual: The site uses the neutral default design system. To brand it, replace the values in `design-system/tokens.css` and rewrite `design-system/README.md` (the skill can do this from a Claude Design System, another repo or a brief), keeping the token names. Then run `pnpm assets` for icons and the social image.
